title: The Remnant of Israel, The Mystery of Israel's Salvation

questions.question: Paul asks: "Has God rejected his people?" What is his immediate response to this?
options: By no means! For I myself am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, a member of the tribe of Benjamin.
Yes, for a time, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in.
He has rejected those who pursued righteousness by the law.
No, but he has set them aside to provoke them to jealousy.
questions.correctAnswer: By no means! For I myself am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, a member of the tribe of Benjamin.
questions.explanation: Romans 11:1 (ESV): "I ask, then, has God rejected his people? By no means! For I myself am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, a member of the tribe of Benjamin."

questions.question: God has not rejected his people whom he foreknew. Paul uses the example of Elijah appealing to God against Israel. What was God's reply to Elijah?
options: "I have kept for myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal."
"I will raise up a remnant in the latter days to restore the kingdom."
"Do not despair, for my covenant with Abraham stands forever."
"I have reserved a faithful few who still seek my face."
questions.correctAnswer: "I have kept for myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal."
questions.explanation: Romans 11:4 (ESV): "But what is God's reply to him? 'I have kept for myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal.'"

questions.question: So too at the present time there is a remnant, chosen by ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 11:5 (ESV): "So too at the present time there is a remnant, chosen by grace."

questions.question: What then? Israel failed to obtain what it was seeking. The elect obtained it, but the rest were ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 11:7 (ESV): "What then? Israel failed to obtain what it was seeking. The elect obtained it, but the rest were hardened,"

questions.question: God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that would not see and ears that would not hear, down to this very day. Who does Paul quote saying "Let their table become a snare and a trap"?
questions.explanation: Romans 11:9 (ESV): "And David says, 'Let their table become a snare and a trap, a stumbling block and a retribution for them;'"

questions.question: Did they stumble in order that they might fall? By no means! Rather, through their trespass, salvation has come to the Gentiles, so as to make Israel ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 11:11 (ESV): "So I ask, did they stumble in order that they might fall? By no means! Rather, through their trespass salvation has come to the Gentiles, so as to make Israel jealous."

questions.question: If their trespass means riches for the world, and if their failure means riches for the Gentiles, how much more will their ____ mean!
questions.explanation: Romans 11:12 (ESV): "Now if their trespass means riches for the world, and if their failure means riches for the Gentiles, how much more will their full inclusion mean!"

questions.question: Paul magnifies his ministry to the Gentiles in order to make his fellow Jews jealous, and thus ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 11:13-14 (ESV): "Inasmuch then as I am an apostle to the Gentiles, I magnify my ministry in order somehow to make my fellow Jews jealous, and thus save some of them."

questions.question: If the dough offered as firstfruits is holy, so is the whole lump, and if the root is holy, so are the ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 11:16 (ESV): "If the dough offered as firstfruits is holy, so is the whole lump, and if the root is holy, so are the branches."

questions.question: Paul warns the Gentile believers not to be arrogant toward the broken-off branches (unbelieving Jews). For if they boast, they should remember it is not they who support the root, but ____.
options: Christ who is the true vine
questions.explanation: Romans 11:18 (ESV): "do not be arrogant toward the branches. If you are, remember it is not you who support the root, but the root that supports you."

questions.question: If God did not spare the natural branches, neither will he spare the grafted ones. Therefore, note the kindness and ____ of God.
questions.explanation: Romans 11:22 (ESV): "Note then the kindness and the severity of God: severity toward those who have fallen, but God's kindness to you, provided you continue in his kindness. Otherwise you too will be cut off."

questions.question: Lest you be wise in your own sight, I do not want you to be unaware of this mystery: a partial hardening has come upon Israel, until ____.
options: the fullness of the Gentiles has come in
the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled
the return of the Son of Man
the appointed time of the Father
questions.correctAnswer: the fullness of the Gentiles has come in
questions.explanation: Romans 11:25 (ESV): "a partial hardening has come upon Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in."

questions.question: As regards the gospel, they are enemies for your sake. But as regards election, they are beloved for the sake of ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 11:28 (ESV): "As regards the gospel, they are enemies for your sake. But as regards election, they are beloved for the sake of their forefathers."

questions.question: For the gifts and the calling of God are ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 11:29 (ESV): "For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable."

questions.question: Paul ends chapter 11 with a doxology. "For from him and through him and ____ are all things. To him be glory forever. Amen."
questions.explanation: Romans 11:36 (ESV): "For from him and through him and to him are all things. To him be glory forever. Amen."

key_verse_text: Oh, the depth of the riches and wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments and how inscrutable his ways!
